title: A Undertow for the Radiators
author: Dominic Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Dunmore, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
